cached_primary_definition_observations.text: There are three DMRs in the 14q32-imprinted region, which can regulate the entire imprinted gene cluster [ 29 ]. Two of these DMRs, DMR-1 and DMR- 2, are intergenic (IG-DMRs) and are located in close proximity to each other between the  DLK1  and  MEG3  genes. The third, DMR-3, is located in the promoter region of the  MEG3  gene (MEG3-DMR). By bisulfite TA cloning and sequencing we determined the DNA methylation pattern in genomic regions designated site A (which includes DMR- 2) and two CpG islands at sites B and C (Figure  1A ).
